+def smooth_polyline(points: np.ndarray, spacing_px: float = 6.0) -> np.ndarray:

+    # polygon corners.  Clamp phantom endpoints to avoid overshoot at the ends.

+    for i in range(len(p) - 1):

+        n = max(4, int(np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1) / 1.2))
